meta.title: Session cleanup
meta.description: Delete sessions into a recoverable trash, clean up sessions orphaned by deleted workspaces, and group workspaces into categories.

title: Session cleanup
subtitle: Sessions whose workspace is gone, plus everything you deleted here.
emptyOrphans: No orphaned sessions. Every stored session still belongs to a workspace.
sectionOrphansHint: These sessions are still on disk, but the workspace they were created in is no longer registered.
sectionTrashHint: Restore puts a session back; permanent deletion cannot be undone.
menuHint: Recoverable: the session goes to the Session cleanup trash.
trashHint: Deleting stops the session's running work first. Files stay on disk until you delete them permanently.
